en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.251 - Abdur Rahman ibn Muslim, known as Sa'dan, said:

"I was in the middle room of the bathhouse when Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) entered, wearing a cloth over the Nuura (depilatory paste)." Imam (as) said: 'Peace be upon you,' I returned the greeting also. Then I entered the room with the basin, performed my ablution, and left.
